name: klar-backend-services
description: Root workspace to run all Klar backend microservices

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -c "cyan,blue,green,magenta,yellow,red,gray" -n "AUTH,FLIGHT,HOTEL-SEARCH,HOTEL-BOOK,PAYMENT,EMAIL,CABS" "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix flight-service run dev" "npm --prefix hotel-search-service run dev" "npm --prefix hotel-booking-service run dev" "npm --prefix payment-service run dev" "npm --prefix email-service run dev" "npm --prefix cabs-service run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -c "cyan,blue,green,magenta,yellow,red,gray,white,bgBlue,bgMagenta,bgYellow,bgGreen" -n "AUTH,FLIGHT,HOTEL-SEARCH,HOTEL-BOOK,PAYMENT,EMAIL,CABS,INSURANCE,CHARTER,PASSPORT,TOUR,VISA" "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix flight-service run dev" "npm --prefix hotel-search-service run dev" "npm --prefix hotel-booking-service run dev" "npm --prefix payment-service run dev" "npm --prefix email-service run dev" "npm --prefix cabs-service run dev" "npm --prefix insurance-service run dev" "npm --prefix charter-service run dev" "npm --prefix passport-service run dev" "npm --prefix tour-package-service run dev" "npm --prefix visa-service run dev"
scripts.install:core: npm --prefix auth-service install && npm --prefix flight-service install && npm --prefix hotel-search-service install && npm --prefix hotel-booking-service install && npm --prefix payment-service install && npm --prefix email-service install && npm --prefix cabs-service install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix auth-service install && npm --prefix cabs-service install && npm --prefix charter-service install && npm --prefix email-service install && npm --prefix flight-service install && npm --prefix hotel-booking-service install && npm --prefix hotel-search-service install && npm --prefix insurance-service install && npm --prefix passport-service install && npm --prefix payment-service install && npm --prefix tour-package-service install && npm --prefix visa-service install
